who: J79 (as its brief requires, from audit G8)
decision: **No GPOS fallback for the 2x fonts.** Replaces the part of D42 (2) that keeps "the GPOS reader as the fallback": `uiscale/core/cuf_encode.py` refuses to encode without `uharfbuzz` (a `RuntimeError` naming `upscale/requirements.txt`), because the fallback kerning gives a different fonts pack than the golden one (`uiscale/napoleon/font_golden.json`, pack `5f510b27...`). The `Gpos` reader stays only as a test cross-check. Both packages are hash-locked in `upscale/requirements-ci.txt` (CI and `upscale/pc/setup_env.cmd`).
